_comment: Declared price table for reservations (contracts K). USD per million tokens, Anthropic list prices from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (fetched 2026-10-15). cache_write is the highest write price (1-hour cache, which the claude CLI uses); cache_write_5m is the 5-minute write price. claude-haiku-5-5 rows are its prompts-up-to-100k tier; prompts over 100k tokens cost 5x (input_over_100k etc.). No inference_geo multiplier applies (not requested). Codex runs on a ChatGPT subscription: no list price is declared, so its monetary reservation is unknown and only request/token ceilings apply.
